deals.evidence: Arctos Sports Partners has reached an agreement to buy a 17% stake in the Sacramento Kings in a deal that values the NBA franchise at $1.8 billion
deals.headline: Arctos buys 17% of the Kings at a $1.8bn valuation
deals.seller: Mark Friedman, Brad Jenkins, Mark Mastrov, Andy Miller, Kevin Nagle (exiting LPs)
deals.summary: Arctos and Ranadivé bought out exiting limited partners; Arctos received three board seats. The Kings confirmed the sale on 24 September 2021 (KCRA).

deals.evidence: would give the investment firm a nearly 5% stake in the team at a valuation of $1.5 billion
deals.headline: Dyal nears deal for nearly 5% of the Kings
deals.investor: Dyal Capital (Blue Owl), Dyal HomeCourt fund
deals.summary: Reuters, citing the WSJ, reported a nearly 5% stake at a $1.5bn valuation; Sportico (2026) confirms the Blue Owl sports fund holds a Kings stake.

ownership_summary: Controlled by chairman Vivek Ranadivé, whose group bought the Kings in 2013 at a $535m valuation. Institutional minority holders: Arctos Sports Partners (17%, 2021, $1.8bn valuation, three board seats) and Blue Owl's sports fund (originally Dyal HomeCourt), which reported a nearly 5% stake at $1.5bn in 2021.
